title: Articulating South Asian Futures: Projects, Practices, and Emplacement — Dissertation Workshop
host: Association for Asian Studies (AAS South Asia Council), with support from the Henry Luce Foundation
theme: Articulating South Asian Futures: Projects, Practices, and Emplacement
description: A dissertation workshop for advanced doctoral candidates writing dissertations on South Asia, sponsored by the AAS South Asia Council with funding from the Henry Luce Foundation. Held in person October 3-5, 2026 at NYU Shanghai, limited to ten participants, with a virtual pre-meeting one month prior. Applicants may be based anywhere but must attend in person; priority is given to applicants based at institutions in Asia.

deadlines.label: full_paper
deadlines.source_quote: All application materials must be submitted via the AAS application portal by May 30, 2026.

deadlines.label: scholarship
deadlines.source_quote: Letters of recommendation must be emailed directly by your advisor to grants@asianstudies.org no later than May 30, 2026.

eligibility.notes: Participants may be based anywhere in the world but must be able to attend the workshop in Shanghai in person; priority is given to applications from participants based at institutions in Asia. The AAS encourages doctoral candidates across disciplines to apply, with a special invitation to underrepresented disciplines such as performance studies, literary studies, and anthropology/history of migration, religion and media.

funding.name: AAS South Asia Council Dissertation Workshop Grant
funding.amount_note: Covers lowest economy-class airfare from home location to Shanghai, AAS-in-Asia 2027 conference registration fee, shared-room lodging during the workshop, and meals during the workshop.
funding.eligibility_notes: Selected workshop participants only (limited to ten participants); advanced doctoral candidates who have completed their research and are writing their dissertations.
